planet.name: Secret Island
planet.summary: A hidden island tied to ROCKtropia. It runs on Next Island's server and shares many Next Island creatures. You reach it through a travel NPC that charges a Rotten Banana. It has gorilla hunting, three element temples, a Kong boss setup, and its own Club NEVERDIE. MindArk still listed Secret Island as a planet in April 2025, but no first-hand account of the trip newer than 2022 was found.
planet.howToReach: On ROCKtropia, talk to the Secret Island Travel Agent near CND Lagoon behind Club NEVERDIE (by the giant dragon, around 136087, 85024). It costs 1 Rotten Banana (zombie loot) and can be used once per hour. To return, pay 1 CND Banana (gorilla loot) to the Papapo / monkey travel agent at the top of the treehouse by the landing point. You cannot fly off the island.
warnings: Status is unverified. The detailed access route comes from player posts dated 2015 and 2022, plus an undated fan page. 2025-2026 evidence is indirect: MindArk's April 2025 announcement lists Secret Island among planets moving to Genesis Project tech; a Secret Island category appeared on the Entropia Exchange (January 2025); a February 2026 player post says Hell can be reached without tokens 'when you're on RT or SI'; and a 2026 event was broadcast on Secret Island.
The eleven ND 500 Raceway Market creature missions are recorded as broken.
19.12.0 (2026-11-11) stopped new ROCKtropia hunting mission chains. The Club NEVERDIE gorilla kill-point mission is probably closed to new starts.
Pack before you go. Return needs a CND Banana, and you cannot fly off the island.

activities.title: Travel to Secret Island (1 Rotten Banana)
activities.summary: The only way in is the Secret Island Travel Agent on ROCKtropia, who charges 1 Rotten Banana. Rotten Bananas drop from zombies; bigger zombie types reportedly drop them more often. Be careful: 'Rotten Banana Bunch' is a different item and does not work.
steps: Get a Rotten Banana by hunting zombies in Zomhattan (for example Zombie Biker Outlaws) or buy one at auction.
Go to the Secret Island Travel Agent by the giant dragon near CND Lagoon, behind Club NEVERDIE (about 136087, 85024).
Accept the mission to hand in the banana. You are sent to the island.
Bring a CND Banana for the return trip if you have one.

cost.text: One Rotten Banana, from your own zombie hunting or bought from players.

activities.limits: Travel agent can be used once per hour.

cooldown.resetNote: Source: 'you can only use this once every hour'.

locations.label: Secret Island Travel Agent, ROCKtropia (source gives 136087, 85024 without a planet name)

score.rationale: Cheap ticket, but you need to farm or buy bananas both ways.

warnings: Last first-hand walkthrough found is from 2022. One fan page says new arrivals find the agent behind the arrival building, while ROCKtropia-born players find her at Club NEVERDIE.

activities.title: Return to ROCKtropia (1 CND Banana)
activities.summary: To leave, pay 1 CND Banana to the monkey (Papapo) travel agent at the top of the treehouse near the landing point. CND Bananas drop from Island and Mountain Gorillas.
steps: Farm Island Gorillas or Mountain Gorillas for a CND Banana. The blogger found level 8 gorillas and a level 15 wave spawn outside Mountain Gorilla Ridge.
Climb the treehouse with the dragon near the landing point.
Pay the travel agent 1 CND Banana.
requirementsText: Possibly wait an hour after arriving (one fan page)

cost.text: Gorilla hunting, or buy a CND Banana (0.01 PED TT).
cost.markupNote: The 2022 blog saw single CND Bananas listed at 1-3 PED each.

activities.limits: One fan page says you must wait an hour before using the return agent.

score.rationale: Required to leave. Easy if you can kill low-level gorillas.

warnings: Do not try to fly off. The 2015 thread says you must take the dragon back.

activities.title: Fire, Water and Forest temple instances
activities.summary: Each temple needs a matching Sacred skull to enter. Mogwas at the Island Girl Spa reveals a temple location, usable once per hour. A 2022 blog rated Water as the easiest and Forest as second hardest.
steps: Farm gorillas for Sacred skulls (for example the Sacred Water skull from Island Gorillas near VS Gorilla Sanctuary).
Talk to Mogwas at the Island Girl Spa for a temple location (once per hour).
rewards: Temple loot and Essences (used in the Zombie Virus Antidote quest line)

cost.text: Skull farming plus temple ammo and decay.

cooldown.resetNote: Source: 'You can only use Mogwas for a temple location once every hour'.

score.rationale: Unusual instanced content, but expensive and poorly documented.

activities.title: Biodome / Zombie Virus Antidote quest line (Kong)
activities.summary: A long item quest. Collect 7 Fragmented Kong Maps, gather the three Sacred Idols, summon Kongs for 5 Kong Bloods, get a Crystal Skull, and clear the three element temples for Essences. The reward is the Zombie Virus Antidote. The 2022 blog says big fights here are mostly run by high-level players.
steps: Collect 7 Fragmented Kong Maps and combine them in a refiner.
Gather the Fire, Water and Forest Sacred Idols and visit the Island Girl.
Summon Kongs to collect 5 Kong Bloods. Get the Crystal Skull from Mighty Waves.
Clear the three element instances for Essences, then claim the Zombie Virus Antidote.

cost.text: Very high. Several boss fights and item farms.

locations.label: Kong (source gives 36270, 18867 with planet name 'Rocktropia'; this is Secret Island coordinate space)

score.rationale: Prestige end-game grind with unclear current status.

warnings: Outline comes from a community write-up (credited to Kull) with no date. Not confirmed after 2022.

activities.title: Gorilla Kill Points mission (Archibald, Club NEVERDIE)
activities.summary: Archibald the monkey behind the bar in Club NEVERDIE gives a kill-point chain. Any gorilla type counts. Rewards rise to 65.6 PED of BLP Weapon Technology at stage IV. Since 19.12.0 it is probably closed to new starts.
steps: Talk to Archibald behind the bar in Club NEVERDIE.
Kill any gorillas (island, mountain, kong, sacred kong).
rewards: Stage II: up to 16.4 PED Shortblades
Stage III: up to 32.8 PED Handgun
Stage IV: up to 65.6 PED BLP Weapon Technology
requirementsText: Chain started before 2026-11-11 if it counts as a ROCKtropia hunting chain

cost.markupNote: Gorillas also drop CND Bananas, your exit ticket.

score.rationale: Good skill rewards if it is still open to you.

warnings: The joinentropia page lists it under Secret Island but does not say which Club NEVERDIE. The Secret Island club is assumed here.
